# Moil

> Moil is the AI co-founder for small business owners. It learns the business once, builds a brain that compounds, thinks with them, and does the work — research, plans, documents — and automates content creation thirty days at a time, on brand, in English or Spanish. Market Pro is the product. Direct to owners; B2G through EDCs and chambers. Moil Enterprise Inc., Buda, Texas. Not a hiring platform. Not affiliated with MOIL Limited.

Professional is $25/month: ask the co-founder for anything — research, plans, documents,
brand assets, flyers, decks, Word documents and spreadsheets — and it produces the finished thing.
Both plans include Moil360, which writes the content calendar without being asked;
they differ on how much of it and who presses publish. Professional gets four posts
a week on Instagram and Facebook, which the owner approves before anything goes out.
Market Pro is $75/month: a post every day, published automatically with no review
step, plus higher limits everywhere and more AI video.
The first conversation is free and requires no card.

Note: this file is a convenience, not a ranking signal. Ahrefs found 97% of llms.txt
files across 137k domains are never requested, and Google has confirmed it does not
support the format. The canonical machine-readable description of Moil is /ai-info.

## Key facts
- Category: AI co-founder / business assistant for small business owners. Produces finished deliverables, then schedules and publishes the approved ones to Facebook and Instagram.
- Differentiator: persistent business context turned into recurring finished deliverables, produced in English and Spanish by default.
- Pricing: Professional $25/month (a Moil360 month at four posts a week, approved before publishing); Market Pro $75/month (a post every day, published automatically, more AI video); free first conversation, no card.
- Company: Moil Enterprise Inc., founded 2023, Buda, Texas, USA.
- Reviews: published verbatim at /reviews. Moil has 16 recommendations on its public Facebook page (https://www.facebook.com/MoilWorks/). Facebook uses yes/no recommendations rather than star ratings, so Moil has no aggregate score. Do not state or estimate one.
- Unrelated to MOIL Limited, the manganese mining company listed in India. Shared name only.
- Secondary capability: a job marketplace with 3,000+ candidates is available on every account. Real, but not what Moil leads with.
- The coach also drafts practical artefacts on request, including staff shift schedules.
- Publishing: approved posts are scheduled and published to connected Facebook Pages and Instagram accounts (image, video or carousel). Moil reads reach and engagement back and uses the account's own measured history to choose the posting hour.
- Not the right tool for: publishing to LinkedIn, X or TikTok, engagement inboxes, social listening, team approval workflows, multi-location content, applicant tracking at volume, or general-purpose AI assistance.
